content:
- Overestimate prices after recent spikes; model tends to overshoot post-peak sentiment (e.g., +0.02 sentiment → forecast too high).
- Underestimate when sentiment is persistently negative; model fails to adjust downward sharply in bearish mood.
- Lag in correction: model often delays mean reversion, especially after strong sentiment shifts (e.g., sentiment drops → price doesn’t fall immediately).
- Forecast bias toward higher values when sentiment is neutral or slightly positive; model overweights bullish signals.
- Horizon-specific: 30-day forecasts overreact to short-term sentiment volatility; smooth out extremes with 10-day moving average of sentiment.
- Avoid extrapolating recent trend if sentiment reverses; model often continues trend even after sentiment turns negative.
